label: Turn on HDR for full-screen HDR apps
desc: The display switches to HDR by itself while an HDR video or game fills the screen; leave this off if the screen goes blank when it switches

label: Column width
desc: How much of the screen each column takes in the scrolling layout

label: Scroll to the focused window
desc: The row of windows scrolls to keep the window you focus in view

label: Keep the split direction
desc: A window keeps splitting the same way when others close or open

label: Split toward the pointer
desc: A new window opens on the side of the window nearest the pointer

label: Resize toward the pointer
desc: Resizing moves the edge nearest the pointer instead of a fixed edge

label: New window share
desc: How much space a new window takes when it splits another; 1 is half each

label: New window side
desc: Where a new window opens beside the current one

label: Split the focused window
desc: A new window splits the focused window, not the one under the pointer

label: Main window size
desc: How much of the screen the main window takes

label: New windows open as
desc: The main window, a side window, or the same as the focused window

label: New windows at the top
desc: A new side window joins the top of the stack, not the bottom

label: Main window side
desc: Which side of the screen the main window sits on

label: Resize toward the pointer
desc: Resizing moves the edge nearest the pointer instead of a fixed edge

label: Title bars
desc: Add a bar with the window's name above each window

label: Bar height
desc: How tall the title bar is

label: Title text size
desc: How big the window's name is in the bar

label: Blur the bar
desc: The bar turns see-through and blurs what is behind it

label: Close and maximise buttons
desc: Coloured dots on the bar: red closes the window, green makes it full screen

label: Glass windows
desc: Windows get a frosted glass look that bends what is behind them

label: Glass look
desc: From nearly clear to heavy frosting

label: Blur strength
desc: How heavily the glass frosts what is behind the window

label: Glass opacity
desc: How strongly the glass shows over the window

label: Glass brightness
desc: How bright the glass looks

label: Glass shade
desc: A light or dark tint under the glass

label: Glass tint
desc: Colour washed over the glass

label: Picture frame around windows
desc: Tile a picture around each window as its frame

label: Frame picture
desc: The picture tiled around each window

label: Frame picture size
desc: Makes the tiled picture bigger or smaller

label: Smooth scaling
desc: Smooth the picture when it is resized; off keeps sharp pixel edges

label: Blur behind the frame
desc: Blur what shows through the see-through parts of the frame picture

label: Frame thickness
desc: How thick each edge is in pixels: left, right, top, bottom

label: Frame overlap
desc: How far the picture tucks under each window edge, in pixels

label: Lively pointer
desc: The pointer tilts, turns, or stretches as it moves

label: Style
desc: How the pointer moves: it rotates, tilts or stretches

label: Shake to find the pointer
desc: Shake the mouse to make the pointer bigger for a moment

label: Size when shaken
desc: How much the pointer grows when you shake it

label: Animate the focused window
desc: A short effect plays on the window you switch to

label: Style
desc: Flash dims it for a moment, Bounce springs it, Slide nudges it

label: Flash depth
desc: How far the flash dims the window; lower is deeper. Flash style only

label: Bounce strength
desc: How small the window shrinks before it springs back; lower bounces harder

label: Slide height
desc: How far the window hops, in pixels. Slide style only

label: Keyboard sounds
desc: Play a sound on every key press, in every app

label: Sound profile
desc: Which keyboard switch you hear; sound packs you add show here too

label: Volume
desc: How loud the key sounds play

label: Key release sound
desc: Also play a softer sound when you let go of a key

label: Bezier curve P1 x (first control point, X)
desc: Time of the first handle, 0 to 1; eases the start

label: Bezier curve P1 y (first control point, Y)
desc: Progress at the first handle; below 0 pulls back first

label: Bezier curve P2 x (second control point, X)
desc: Time of the second handle, 0 to 1; eases the end

label: Bezier curve P2 y (second control point, Y)
desc: Progress at the second handle; above 1 overshoots

label: Saved curves
desc: Curves saved by name; animations using one follow it

label: New (add curve)
desc: Add a curve with a stock ease shape and edit it

label: Delete / Reset (curve)
desc: Delete a custom curve, or drop a built-in's override

label: Reset to defaults
desc: Clear every animation override and custom curve

label: Border gradient spin · enabled
desc: Spin the border gradient; can keep the GPU busy nonstop

label: Border gradient spin · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Border gradient spin · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window open · enabled
desc: Motion when a window opens; off, new windows just appear

label: Window open · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Window open · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window open · style
desc: Slide in, pop, or gnomed; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Window close fade · enabled
desc: Fade closing windows out; off, they cut at full opacity

label: Window close fade · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Window close fade · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Fades (group) · enabled
desc: All window fading as one group: open, close, dim, shadow

label: Fades (group) · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Fades (group) · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Border colour · enabled
desc: Blends the border colour on focus change instead of snapping

label: Border colour · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Border colour · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Workspace switch · enabled
desc: Motion when switching workspaces; off is a hard cut

label: Workspace switch · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Workspace switch · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Workspace switch · style
desc: Horizontal or vertical slide, fade, or both combined

label: All animations (root) · enabled
desc: Root of the tree; rows below still override it

label: All animations (root) · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: All animations (root) · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window close · enabled
desc: Motion when a window closes; off, windows vanish instantly

label: Window close · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Window close · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window close · style
desc: Slide out, pop, or gnomed; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Panels and menus · enabled
desc: Motion for shell surfaces: launcher, panels, menus

label: Panels and menus · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Panels and menus · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Panels and menus · style
desc: Slide, pop, or fade; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Panels and menus open · enabled
desc: Motion when a panel or menu appears

label: Panels and menus open · style
desc: Slide, pop, or fade; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Panels and menus close · enabled
desc: Motion when a panel or menu goes away

label: Panels and menus close · style
desc: Slide, pop, or fade; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Window open fade · enabled
desc: Fade-in of opening windows; off, they appear at full opacity

label: Window open fade · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Window open fade · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Scratchpad · enabled
desc: Motion when the scratchpad workspace shows or hides

label: Scratchpad · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Scratchpad · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Scratchpad · style
desc: How the scratchpad slides or fades in and out

label: Windows (group) · enabled
desc: Open, close, and move as one; rows below override it

label: Windows (group) · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Windows (group) · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Windows (group) · style
desc: Slide in, pop, or gnomed; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Panels and menus fade in · enabled
desc: Fade shell surfaces in as they appear

label: Panels and menus fade in · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Panels and menus fade in · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Panels and menus fade out · enabled
desc: Fade shell surfaces out as they close

label: Panels and menus fade out · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Panels and menus fade out · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window move · enabled
desc: Motion while windows are moved, dragged, or resized

label: Window move · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Window move · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window move · style
desc: Slide, pop, or gnomed; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Custom layer rules
desc: Blur, dim, or restyle shell surfaces per namespace

label: Namespace
desc: Layer-shell name to match, e.g. launcher; else no effect

label: Action
desc: What the rule does; changing it resets the value

label: Value
desc: Only Ignore alpha uses it: alpha cutoff 0.0 to 1.0

label: Extra borders
desc: Draw one or two extra outlines around each window

label: Number of extra borders
desc: How many extra outlines to draw

label: Border colour
desc: Colour of the first extra outline

label: Border width
desc: How thick the first extra outline is, in pixels

label: Match the window's corners
desc: The outlines follow the window's rounded corners instead of squaring off

label: Touchscreen gestures
desc: Swipe, pinch and long-press to move windows and switch workspaces

label: Gesture sensitivity
desc: How far a finger must move before a gesture counts; raise it on big tablets

label: Long-press time
desc: How long a press must last to count as a long-press, in milliseconds

label: Edge swipe area
desc: How close to the screen edge an edge swipe must start, in pixels

label: Long-press a border to resize
desc: Hold a window's edge with a second finger to resize it

label: Three-finger tap to float
desc: Tap with three fingers to float or tile the window under them
